execution_envelope.distinction: The 600-second bounded execution turn is not the 900-second P0 acceptance window.

startup_measurement.rule: Preserve raw historical samples; classify current v5.4 generation prospectively only from observed boundaries. Invocation metadata alone is not BOOT_STARTED or first useful work.

active_retest.purpose: Verify that the operator can directly observe real same-wake work cadence: provisional schedule trace first, then one trace per durably persisted bounded substantive unit, continued work after each trace, and final exact END+60 next-due trace.
active_retest.success_signal: A normal >=600s CONTINUE wake shows verified provisional schedule trace; >=2 genuine durably persisted bounded-unit completion traces when workload permits; no trace-induced early close; SAME MAIN exact END+60 close trace; no duplicate substantive overlap.
active_retest.failure_signal: Any completion trace without durable unit duration/work evidence, any trace treated as a close boundary, or failure to continue safe authorized work before 600s.

latest_diagnosis.evidence: Self-update capability and exact END+60 scheduling are proven live; operator still lacks direct per-unit same-wake visibility. V5.5 adds chat traces bound strictly to durable unit completion evidence.
latest_diagnosis.implication: Use chat traces to test whether the MAIN is continuously chaining real work rather than returning early. Do not infer useful work from elapsed time or prose alone.

next_corrective_experiment.hypothesis: Binding each progress message to durable unit completion evidence will make premature return and idle gaps directly observable without changing scheduler authority.
next_corrective_experiment.success_signal: Same-wake trace sequence demonstrates schedule arm -> multiple durably evidenced units -> exact END+60 close.
